Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id, then to compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Join molecule_hierarchy on substrate molregno to reach parent_molregno, then join molecule_dictionary to retrieve parent_compound_name from pref_name. Do not deduplicate rows. Return the first 200 rows without sorting.
